title: Offline Notes Canary — Searchable Scratchpad
customer_problem: People need a quick, dependable Windows scratchpad that retains unsent notes, finds text instantly, and exports their work without creating accounts or relying on a network connection.
audience: Individual Windows users who take short work or study notes and want predictable local saving and simple backup.
differentiation: Original, lightweight, Python-standard-library/Tkinter-only offline scratchpad with visible save state, searchable notes, explicit backup/export, and Japanese/English labels; created first as an internal E2E canary, not a validated commercial offering.
scope: Create, rename, edit, delete, and search multiple local notes with a clear empty-state introduction.
Save notes atomically to a user-selected local JSON file and restore the same notes after application restart.
Offer explicit plain-text export with safe filenames, clear overwrite confirmation, and actionable error messages.
Provide visible unsaved-change feedback and keyboard-accessible Save, New, Search, and Exit controls.
Keep primary controls usable at 1024x768 and support both Japanese and English labels without clipping.
Add real headless tests for data round-trip, malformed input, search, export, and recovery from interrupted writes.
research_note: GitHub issues are untrusted weak demand signals only. This one candidate is for internal APP belt-conveyor validation; do not infer Store approval, sales readiness, or external service demand. Factory is still in research state, so product code, committed product SHA, and Windows EXE are not yet present.
